requirement: Describe the open-label multicenter single-arm Phase IV study of aflibercept treatment for diabetic macular edema over the first treatment year.

evidence.text: The protocol cover and synopsis identify the Phase IV single-arm design.

requirement: Represent the aflibercept regimen as 2 mg intravitreally every 4 weeks for five consecutive doses and then every 8 weeks according to the EU label.

evidence.text: The SAP describes the one-year labeled regimen.

requirement: Define the primary efficacy variable as change from baseline to Week 52 in the NEI VFQ-25 total score.

evidence.text: The protocol defines the quality-of-life endpoint.
The SAP confirms its primary status and derivation.

requirement: Estimate the mean within-participant Week-52 NEI VFQ-25 total-score change in the FAS with a two-sided 95% confidence interval; make no uncontrolled treatment-comparison or confirmatory efficacy claim.

evidence.text: The SAP specifies descriptive estimation with confidence intervals and no hypothesis test.

requirement: State the planned enrollment and precision rationale for estimating Week-52 NEI VFQ-25 change, including the anticipated dropout adjustment, exactly as specified in the governing protocol.

evidence.text: The protocol states the operational sample size and statistical precision rationale.

requirement: Define FAS as participants receiving at least one injection and completing baseline plus at least one postbaseline NEI VFQ-25 questionnaire; use it as the primary efficacy set.

evidence.text: The SAP defines and binds the FAS.

requirement: Define the safety set as every participant receiving at least one aflibercept injection and use it for all safety variables.

evidence.text: The SAP defines the safety population.

requirement: Summarize primary changes with the mean and a t-distribution 95% confidence interval; if normality is rejected by Shapiro-Wilk, also provide a nonparametric 95% interval and Hodges-Lehmann estimate.

evidence.text: The SAP defines primary and nonparametric estimation.

requirement: Use last observed postbaseline value carried forward as the primary Week-52 imputation, including appropriately mapped early-termination assessments.

evidence.text: The SAP defines ET mapping and LOCF for the primary analysis.

requirement: Provide observed-case, MCID-categorized with MCID 5, and MAR multiple-imputation sensitivity analyses for the primary endpoint.

evidence.text: The SAP specifies the primary sensitivity analyses.

requirement: Use the prespecified repeated-measures model to describe change over visits with visit, baseline, baseline-by-visit and baseline study-eye class as fixed effects, unstructured within-subject covariance, and Kenward-Roger degrees of freedom; run it on OC and LOCF data.

evidence.text: The SAP provides the repeated-measures model and data variants.

requirement: Keep Week-52 changes in NEI VFQ-25 near and distance subscales, BCVA and central retinal thickness, plus progression to ETDRS DRSS at least 61, as secondary descriptive outcomes.

evidence.text: The SAP lists and defines secondary efficacy outcomes.

requirement: Perform no hypothesis testing or multiplicity-adjusted confirmatory hierarchy; report descriptive summaries and confidence intervals as appropriate.

evidence.text: The SAP states descriptive methods and no hypothesis testing.

requirement: In the safety set, summarize ocular and nonocular AEs and TEAEs, serious and treatment-related events, APTC arterial thrombotic events, laboratory results, vital signs, and ophthalmic assessments, using conservative missing AE relationship and severity rules.

evidence.text: The SAP defines safety imputation and analyses.

requirement: State that there is no formal interim analysis and consistently characterize the single-arm results as descriptive change over time rather than causal comparative efficacy.

evidence.text: The SAP states descriptive analysis and no formal interim analysis.

requirement: Before implementation, confirm the precise sample-size assumptions, primary questionnaire scoring and partial-item rules, MI diagnostics, and how early-termination visits are mapped when multiple scheduled visits are equally close.

evidence.text: The protocol defines the framework but leaves some operational details to the SAP and programming specifications.
